activationBasis: Nathan approved Yogi OTA source work only (relayed by Chief, 2026-11-05). No build, key, access, signing, publication, dispatch or phone action is authorized by this file. Publication and automation stay false until separately authorized.

builder.basis: Dedicated Yogi VM from the handoff: n2-standard-64, 2,000 GB SSD, last documented TERMINATED. It has no service account, GitHub runner or CI identity yet; status stays runner-unregistered until Infra registers the runner and the controller identity can get/start/stop only this instance. Never shared with Frankel, Mustang, Rango, Blazer or Agent builds.

signing.basis: A Yogi-only OS key set; no other device's keys. The containers do not exist yet. Public pins (OTA certificate, AVB public key) exist only after the separately authorized bootstrap writes its receipt; nothing here claims them. Signing reads remain refused while status is not approved with an unexpired window.

labBaseline.reason: Established from the recorded artifact inspection: no packaged Updater, test-keys build tags, public AOSP development AVB and app identities. Not established: that the phone runs exactly this artifact (no installed-build readback), its installed OTA trust contents, and whether any sideload or data-preserving transition is possible. Proposed supported design: a one-time, separately authorized wipe installation of the Yogi bootstrap build (userdata and metadata erased), then in-place OTAs.

bootstrap.basis: Build A: the first Yogi-key image with the owned Updater, delivered as a private fastboot install image. Every published Yogi OTA must be newer than it and signed by the same Yogi identity.

allocationFloor.basis: Lab candidate identity; every allocated Yogi build number and BUILD_DATETIME is strictly greater.

appInputs.basis: Fleet Rose app identity, already signed by the existing app signer (never signed on the Yogi builder). Bound to the Frankel 2026110403 set Mustang also uses (dev.pixel.voice 364, dev.pixel.calculator.agent 5, dev.pixel.backgroundcontrol 38; allocationSha256 f004a4c6...), per Release 2026-11-05. Status stays unbound until Release's export delivers those signed-apps and background-policy.json to the Yogi builder (directory); the pipeline re-verifies signer, receipts, versions and policy before integration.
